resources.string: Warden uses accessibility to detect when a blocked app or website is opened so it can show the block screen. Warden never collects, stores, or transmits the content of your screen.
Android 13 and newer lock this setting for apps installed from an APK file. To unlock it:
1. Open Settings → Accessibility → Warden, tap it once and confirm the message.
2. Tap “Open app info” below → ⋮ (top right) → “Allow restricted settings”.
3. Go back to Accessibility and turn Warden on.
Switch greyed out? Setup shows how to unlock it.
Prevents Warden from being uninstalled while blocking is active. Warden requests no other admin powers.
